title: Dream Bot Team for UEFN: the manual
intro: A team of AI agents for your UEFN maps, a console to watch them work, and a kit that learns from every map you build. Start with the 15-minute quick start, or jump to the chapter you need.

summaries.welcome: What the kit is, what it does for you, what it does not do.
summaries.quick-start: From zero to a first working session.
summaries.your-team: The 17 agents, the model each one runs on, and when to call them.
summaries.the-console: The six pages of the local console, one by one.
summaries.skills-and-lessons: How the kit learns from your maps and what you approve.
summaries.community: Share a lesson, get everyone's: how it works and what stays private.
summaries.troubleshooting: Updates, the doctor, and the most common problems.
summaries.install: Everything the quick start leaves out: plugins, upgrades, updating a project safely.
summaries.daily-work: Calling agents, the plan-first flow, the base rules and what runs after a playtest.
summaries.skill-catalog: Every skill, what it does and when it is used.
summaries.faq: Short answers to the questions people ask first.
summaries.about: Who made the kit, how to follow along, the license.
summaries.mcp-engine: Mapping everything UEFN's MCP offers, and noticing what Epic adds.
